gen-indie-flower-outfit: Relaxed and inviting, Indie Flower looks hand-drawn, its letters knotted close like cord, while Outfit sits smooth and unshaded beneath. Outfit's sans reads smoothly, though it was made for brief visits.
gen-indie-flower-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans lands crisp and precise with monoline strokes, sitting under Indie Flower's relaxed, hand-drawn heading. Its charm is loose against tidy, best kept away from long paragraphs.
gen-indie-flower-space-grotesk: Hand-drawn warmth with a geometric spine underneath. Indie Flower's loose, knotted letters rub openly against Space Grotesk's constant-width lines, which keeps things lively, though long paragraphs would tire it.
gen-irish-grover-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: BhuTuka Expanded One sets a deliberate pace, its curvy serif letters feeling pleasantly unclamped. BhuTuka Expanded One feels authoritative beside Irish Grover's fun, sturdy, organic bounce.
gen-irish-grover-gf-hepta-slab: Irish Grover is fun and organic, its words standing tall. It excels at making words look sturdy, while Hepta Slab does its best work stretching out bookish, dignified lines of constant width.
gen-irish-grover-gf-padyakke-expanded-on: Padyakke Expanded One reads literary and authoritative, its glyphs spread like knots on a slack rope, every stroke the same gauge. Irish Grover's felt-marker softness against that rigid gauge is the spark.
gen-irish-grover-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Sturdy, organic fun up top, with Irish Grover's open-throated letters standing large. Stint Ultra Expanded drifts beneath with each character floating apart, pen-plotter smooth and traditional, an authoritative foil for the fun heading.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Luckiest Guy shouts cheerfully, its poured-ink letters set high with a clearly open e. BhuTuka Expanded One lets paragraphs unfold at a leisurely walk, its serif curves literary and unclamped.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-hepta-slab: Loud cheer up top, bookish dignity below. Luckiest Guy is best at shouting from a high-set mean line, while Hepta Slab does its finest work with open counters and stretched-out words.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-padyakke-expanded-on: A mean line set high gives Luckiest Guy its loud cheer. That heading is best at poured-ink volume, while Padyakke Expanded One does its finest work in wide-mouthed, slack-spaced literary lines.
